\[ 0.1361 \, \text{meters} \times 32 \, \text{pixels/meter} \approx 4.3552 \, \text{pixels} \]

Thus, the purple circle will have fallen approximately 4.3552 pixels from its initial position. Since the initial position is at the top of the image, the new position will be around 4.3552 pixels from the top.
